# Required Pi 4 SD FAT boot files. Fields: path, minimum bytes, check.
# Checks: config (Pi boot contract), cmdline (UART console), kernel (non-zero
# AArch64 flat image), fdt (big-endian 0xd00dfeed magic), none.
config.txt 1 config
cmdline.txt 1 cmdline
kernel8.img 65536 kernel
bcm2711-rpi-4-b.dtb 1024 fdt
bootcode.bin 4096 none
start4.elf 1048576 none
fixup4.dat 1024 none
LICENCE.broadcom 1 none
overlays/disable-bt.dtbo 512 fdt
